This file opens straight into prose with no heading at all — the first line
is body text, not an H1. The migration helper must synthesise a title from
the filename rather than reading one off the top of the file.

The rest of the document is ordinary notes. There is nothing structurally
special here beyond the missing heading; the point is purely that `migrate`
cannot harvest an H1 and has to invent one.

## A later section

Subsequent `##` headings are fine — only the leading H1 is absent.
